command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-16. "Same API contract" is an acceptance condition, and so far this lane has
# only exercised part of the surface: /api/version, /api/tags, /api/show, /api/generate, /api/embed,
# /api/ps and /v1/models. The endpoints HERMES clients most likely depend on -- the chat ones, native
# and OpenAI-compatible -- have not been touched. The pinned runtime is v0.9.2 where the superseded
# container ran a much later build, so "the endpoints are surely still there" is exactly the kind of
# assumption this lane should not be making about its own claim. Exercise them.

$base = 'http://127.0.0.1:11434'
function Try-Endpoint($name, $script) {
    try { & $script; } catch { Write-Output "$name FAILED :: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
}

Write-Output '--- /api/chat (native) ---'
Try-Endpoint '/api/chat' {
    $body = @{ model = 'llama3.2:3b'; stream = $false; options = @{ num_predict = 24; temperature = 0 }
        messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'Reply with exactly one word: commissioned' }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod "$base/api/chat" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 300
    Write-Output "/api/chat OK role=$($r.message.role) content=$($r.message.content.Trim() -replace '\s+', ' ') done=$($r.done)"
}

Write-Output '--- /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible) ---'
Try-Endpoint '/v1/chat/completions' {
    $body = @{ model = 'llama3.2:3b'; max_tokens = 24; temperature = 0
        messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'Reply with exactly one word: commissioned' }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod "$base/v1/chat/completions" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 300
    Write-Output "/v1/chat/completions OK id=$($r.id) model=$($r.model) finish=$($r.choices[0].finish_reason) content=$($r.choices[0].message.content.Trim() -replace '\s+', ' ')"
    Write-Output "   usage prompt=$($r.usage.prompt_tokens) completion=$($r.usage.completion_tokens)"
}

Write-Output '--- /v1/completions ---'
Try-Endpoint '/v1/completions' {
    $body = @{ model = 'llama3.2:3b'; prompt = 'One word:'; max_tokens = 8; temperature = 0 } | ConvertTo-Json
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod "$base/v1/completions" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 300
    Write-Output "/v1/completions OK finish=$($r.choices[0].finish_reason)"
}

Write-Output '--- /v1/embeddings (the path the inference proxy used) ---'
Try-Endpoint '/v1/embeddings' {
    $body = @{ model = 'snowflake-arctic-embed2:latest'; input = 'commissioning probe' } | ConvertTo-Json
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod "$base/v1/embeddings" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 300
    Write-Output "/v1/embeddings OK dims=$($r.data[0].embedding.Count) model=$($r.model)"
}

Write-Output '--- /api/embeddings (legacy singular) ---'
Try-Endpoint '/api/embeddings' {
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod "$base/api/embeddings" -Method Post -Body (@{ model = 'snowflake-arctic-embed2:latest'; prompt = 'probe' } | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 300
    Write-Output "/api/embeddings OK dims=$($r.embedding.Count)"
}

Write-Output '--- CONTEXT-LENGTH-BEHAVIOUR ---'
# v0.9.2 defaults OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH to 4096. williamos-qwen3-4b is tagged :64k. Check whether the
# full context is reachable per-request, so the limitation can be stated exactly rather than vaguely.
Try-Endpoint 'num_ctx' {
    $body = @{ model = 'williamos-qwen3-4b:64k'; prompt = 'Reply with one word: ok'; stream = $false
        options = @{ num_predict = 8; num_ctx = 32768; temperature = 0 } } | ConvertTo-Json
    $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod "$base/api/generate" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 600
    $sw.Stop()
    Write-Output "num_ctx=32768 request OK wall_ms=$($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds) response=$($r.response.Trim() -replace '\s+', ' ')"
}
try { (Invoke-RestMethod "$base/api/ps" -TimeoutSec 20).models | ForEach-Object { "resident=$($_.name) size_vram=$($_.size_vram)" } } catch { }
& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' --query-gpu=uuid,temperature.gpu,power.draw,memory.used --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
